name: Master QR Code Generator – Fast & Easy QR Code Solution
author: Sharabindu

sections.description:
Automatically generate and display QR codes for WordPress posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and custom post types.

Master QR Generator is a powerful and user-friendly WordPress QR code generator plugin that lets you create professional QR codes directly from your WordPress dashboard. Customize colors, shapes, eyes, logos, and styles with ease. No coding required.

Generate QR codes for multiple content types including URLs, text, phone numbers, email, WiFi access, vCard, Google Maps, WhatsApp Chat, and more.

Key Features

⚡ Automatically Generate QR Codes for All WordPress Content

Save time with automated QR code creation! Master QR Generator automatically generates and displays dynamic QR codes for your Posts, Pages, WooCommerce Products, and Custom Post Types without any manual setup.

🎯 Supports 9+ QR Code Content Types

Instantly generate functional QR codes for:

Web URLs & Custom Links

Plain Text & Messages

Email Addresses

Phone Numbers & SMS

Wi-Fi Credentials

Google Maps Locations (Latitude & Longitude)

WhatsApp Direct Chat

vCards (Contact Information)

🎨 Complete Visual & Style Customization

Customize colors, eye styles, shapes, and sizes

Transform standard designs using DotScale styling technology

Add your brand logo or custom icons to the center of any QR code

Generate sleek, high-res, and modern QR designs effortlessly

🧩 Effortless Display Anywhere on Your Site

Easy-to-use Shortcodes for any location

100% compatible with all major WordPress themes & page builders (Elementor, Divi, etc.)

📥 One-Click High-Resolution Downloads

Download generated QR codes as crisp PNG images instantly for print or marketing materials

No coding required • 100% Beginner-Friendly • Built for Marketers, WooCommerce Stores, Businesses & Agencies.

Why Use Master QR Code Generator?

Master QR Code Generator helps you boost engagement, increase conversions, and connect offline users to your online content easily.

Ideal for:
– Marketing campaigns
– Product packaging
– Event promotions
– Magazine ads
– Business cards
– Contactless menus
– Service promotions
– Store locations

This plugin helps you build interactive, scannable experiences that improve user engagement and brand visibility.

Premium Features Explained

Try the Demo | Premium version | Documents

Stylish QR Codes for WordPress

Use DotScale customization to create beautiful, unique, and branded QR codes.

Custom Text / Number / Link QR

Quickly generate QR codes for text, contact numbers, or any custom URL.

Google Map QR Code

Add your business location using Google Maps QR codes. Supports latitude and longitude.

WhatsApp Chat QR Code

Create instant WhatsApp chat QR codes by entering your WhatsApp number.

WiFi QR Code

Allow visitors to connect to your Wi-Fi network by scanning a QR code.

Email Address QR Code

Share email addresses instantly via QR code.

Phone Number QR Code

Visitors can call you instantly with one scan.

vCard QR Code

Generate digital business card QR codes containing full contact details.

EXTRA FEATURES FOR PREMIUM

► ADD QR CODE EYE COLOR: Make QR code attractive using QR code eye color in the premium version

► ADD QR CODE EYE BORDER COLOR: Make QR code attractive using QR code eye border color in the premium version

► ADD QR CODE VERTICAL TIMING COLOR: Make QR code attractive using QR code Vertical Timing Color in the premium version.

► ADD QR CODE HAORIZONTAL TIMING COLOR: Make QR code attractive using QR code Haorizontal Timing Color in the premium version.

► ADD CENTER LOGO: The premium version allows you to place your website’s Brand logo/image in the center of the QR code.

► ADD BACKGROUND IMAGE: The premium version allows you to place your website’s Brand logo/image in the background of the QR code.

► BULK VCARD QR CODE GENERATOR: In the premium version, you can create as many vCard QR codes as you want. vCard allows the sharing of basic information like name, contact information, job title, address, and website URL via QR code.

► ADD LOGO FOR DIFFERENT POST TYPES: You can set different logo based on post type. So you can manage the brand logo and increase brand value with a QR code. Upload different images based on different post types and improve site quality. View Demo

► SHORTCODE WITH ATTRIBUTES:In the free version, you can use QR code shortcode one time. But in the premium version, you can use attributes for each shortcode. You can design QR codes differently using the shortcode features, change content elements, and generate QR codes in bulk using the features. Read Docs.

► WORDPRESS WIDGET SUPPORTED: The premium plugin has powerful WordPress widget facilities for creating QR. You can easily create custom text, links, current page links, numbers, WhatsApp chat access, and tax code for email addresses using this widget.

► QR CODE GENERATE WITH ELEMENTOR: Elementor users can easily generate QR codes with the “Master QR” addon. Master QR addon is excellent for generating current page URLs, custom links, email addresses, phone numbers, wifi access, WhatsApp chat, and vCard QR code.

► QR CODE BULK PRINT: Post-type-based QR codes can be easily printed from one page. In bulk print settings, you can choose a post type like ‘Product’, ‘Post’, ‘Page’, ‘Custom Post’, etc., for filtering. You will receive a printout as a PDF. Live Demo :

► DOWNLOAD QR CODES FROM ONE PAGE: This is a powerful advantage for the website owner. They can easily download QR images from one page. This option is available for post-type QR. Live Demo :

And many more things are waiting for you to discover

sections.installation:
Follow these simple steps to install and start using Master QR Generator:

📥 Automatic Installation (Recommended)
Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.

Go to Plugins » Add New.

In the search bar, type Master QR Generator.

Click Install Now next to the plugin.

Once installed, click Activate.

📦 Manual Installation
Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress Plugin Directory.

Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.

Navigate to Plugins » Add New and click Upload Plugin.

Select the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.

After installation, click Activate Plugin.

🚀 Getting Started
After activation:

Go to Master QR Generator in your WordPress dashboard.

Choose your desired QR code type.

Customize the appearance.

Generate and download or embed your QR code using a shortcode.
sections.faq:
How does automatic QR code generation work?

Once activated, Master QR Generator automatically creates dynamic QR codes for your WordPress posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and custom post types. You don’t need to manually input URLs or build codes one by one.

Can I customize the design of my QR codes?

Yes! You can fully customize your QR codes by changing colors, shapes, eye styles, and overall dimensions. You can also upload your own brand logo or custom icon to place in the center of the QR code.

How do I display QR codes on my website?

You can display QR codes anywhere on your site using our built-in Gutenberg block or simple shortcodes. It works seamlessly with popular page builders like Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and standard WordPress themes.

Can visitors download the QR codes?

Yes, you can allow users or admins to download high-resolution PNG versions of the generated QR codes with a single click—perfect for printing on flyers, product packaging, or invoices.

What types of content can I convert into QR codes?

In addition to automatically generating URL codes for your site’s content, you can manually create QR codes for custom links, plain text, email addresses, phone numbers, SMS, Wi-Fi credentials, Google Maps locations, WhatsApp chat, and vCards.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

Not at all. Master QR Generator is 100% beginner-friendly and features an intuitive interface inside your WordPress dashboard with no technical knowledge required.

Is Master QR Generator compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, it fully supports WooCommerce. QR codes are automatically generated for product pages, making it easy for customers to scan, save, or share product links.
